verdict.rationale: Poke is itself an AI assistant/agent, so it sits in the MCP client role. All MCP evidence (poke-docs-3, -4, -16, -35) describes Poke connecting to and consuming external MCP servers, which belongs to the MCP-client story and is not credited here. The probe pointing to /docs/mcp-servers refers to that same client-side page, and nothing documents Poke exposing its own MCP server or endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
